title: MarkerSuperElementRigid and MarkerKinematicTreeRigid keep text in HTML comments
author: Claude-JG
description: The detailed descriptions of MarkerSuperElementRigid and MarkerKinematicTreeRigid carry tables and equations inside HTML comments (<!-- ... -->, remains of the LaTeX conversion), which are in the definition and on no page. Each part is either restored as Markdown, checked against the C++, or deleted. Left open by revision2026b step RG13.4 (#2721); revision2026b step RG13.5.3.1.
releaseNotes: MarkerKinematicTreeRigid has a full description - its quantities from the link frame, the Jacobians of revolute and prismatic joints and the generalized forces -, and MarkerSuperElementRigid says how rotationsExponentialMap changes its rotation matrix and angular velocity.
